label: Start a task
description: A step of an events automation: starts a task of `workflow` in the same project, with `inputs` and an optional `title`, and records that the events task started it because of `event`. It does not wait for that task; `task_id` names it, and `event` is handed on unchanged so the next step can read it (`.children.<this step>.output.event`). Every input is optional so a mount can be wired by its line's own `inputs` alone; a start with no `workflow` fails at run time.

workflow.description: The workflow the new task runs — its root state id, e.g. feature/review.

inputs.description: The new task's inputs, by name.

title.description: The new task's title. Absent: the workflow's id.

event.description: The event the automation fired on — `.event` — which a started task's card names as where it came from. Unconstrained: `.event` is typed by nothing a checker can see.
The event this step was handed, for the next step.
